clue.text: City animal — about half's half

indicators.note: about means going round, so the animal's letters surround the other piece

parts.note: a beast is any animal

indicators.note: half here takes the second half of the word half, its last two letters

explanation.surface: A puzzling riddle about an animal and fractions of a half.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half's half' does not mean a quarter: it is the second half of the written word half, and 'about' wraps the animal round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Belfast is the capital city of Northern Ireland.

clue.text: City of fashion

parts.note: points to the old naval phrase 'shipshape and ... fashion', named after a West Country port city

explanation.surface: A city known for its style.
explanation.walkthrough: Not Milan or Paris: the fashion is the nautical 'shipshape and Bristol fashion', meaning neat and in good order.
explanation.definitionFit: The English port city gave its name to the sailors' phrase for things kept tidy and seaworthy.

clue.text: Rape victim gives money to church

parts.note: lucre is money, usually filthy lucre
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A victim of assault hands cash to the church.
explanation.walkthrough: The victim is the heroine of Shakespeare's poem The Rape of Lucrece.
explanation.definitionFit: Lucrece is the Roman matron raped by Tarquin in Shakespeare's narrative poem.

clue.text: Dumbledore is a number on public transport

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
a bus is public transport

explanation.surface: Harry Potter's headmaster turns out to be a bus route number.
explanation.definitionFit: Albus is the first name of Professor Dumbledore in the Harry Potter books.

clue.text: Match religious group with flying guinea pig?

parts.note: a Test is an international cricket match
PI is short for pious, religious
a lot is a group or batch

explanation.surface: Combining a sports fixture with a sect to produce an airborne experimental animal.
explanation.walkthrough: PI (pious) is a crossword staple for religious.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who tries out new aircraft is, figuratively, the one experimented on in the air.

clue.text: Trust devouring energy — don't go off it

indicators.note: devouring means taking in, so the trust word swallows the energy letter

parts.note: to depend on is to trust
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Advice that a hungry trust should keep its temper.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on the idiom 'go off the deep end', to lose one's temper.
explanation.definitionFit: Going off the deep end means losing control, so the advice warns against leaving that part of the pool.

clue.text: City matched with neighbour

definitions.meaning: a cathedral city in the English East Midlands
a local ... is a match between two nearby rival teams

explanation.surface: A town playing against the town next door.
explanation.definitionFit: Derby is an English city, and a derby is a game between neighbouring sides.

clue.text: Eat last course first and send hot food back to city

indicators.note: the final letter of the eating word moves to the front

parts.note: to dine is to eat

indicators.note: send ... back puts the hot food letters in reverse order
with send, signals that these letters are read backwards

parts.note: H is the tap abbreviation for hot
grub is slang for food

explanation.surface: Instructions to eat dessert first and return a hot dish, then head to a city.
explanation.walkthrough: DINE becomes EDIN; H + GRUB sent back is BURGH.
explanation.definitionFit: Edinburgh is the capital city of Scotland.

clue.text: Prohibition? I've kept my head about it

indicators.note: kept means held inside, so the self word holds the other letters

parts.note: the ego is the I, the self

indicators.note: head means the first letter of my

parts.note: it refers back to the prohibition, a bar

explanation.surface: Someone claims to have stayed calm amid a ban.
explanation.walkthrough: EGO keeps M plus BAR, the 'it' that the question names.
explanation.definitionFit: An embargo is an official ban, especially on trade with a country.

clue.text: Deposit required from badly flawed student

indicators.note: badly signals that the letters are put together wrongly

parts.note: L is the learner driver's plate, a student

explanation.surface: A flawed student is required to pay a deposit.
explanation.definitionFit: Dew is moisture deposited on surfaces overnight, and its settling is called this.

clue.text: Burden for young animal breaking in America

indicators.note: breaking in means bursting into the other letters

parts.note: US is the United States
a cub is a young animal such as a fox or bear

explanation.surface: A young animal breaking into America is a burden.
explanation.definitionFit: An incubus is something that oppresses like a nightmare, hence a heavy burden.

clue.text: Colours used by artist in front

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
the bow is the front of a ship

explanation.surface: An artist uses colours at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: The spectrum of seven colours appears in the sky as an arc.

clue.text: Religion of the opposition with strange hoops to go through

indicators.note: to go through means passing inside, so the shuffled hoops sit within the opposition word

parts.note: they are the people on the other side, the opposition

indicators.note: strange signals a rearrangement of letters

explanation.surface: A rival faith that makes people jump through odd hoops.
explanation.definitionFit: Theosophy is a mystical religious philosophy founded by Madame Blavatsky.

clue.text: Polish backing for king with a cover that's almost complete

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the polishing word is turned round

parts.note: to rub is to polish
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Polish support for a king with a nearly full covering.
explanation.definitionFit: A burka is a garment covering a woman's whole body, with at most a mesh for the eyes.

clue.text: Intercity waterway they say guides organ game

indicators.note: they say indicates a word spoken rather than written

parts.note: guides means leads
the liver is a bodily organ
pool is a cue game

explanation.surface: A pun-laden description of a canal leading to a church organ.
explanation.walkthrough: The canal crosses the Pennines, linking two northern English cities.
explanation.definitionFit: The Leeds and Liverpool Canal is a long English waterway joining two cities.

clue.text: City life with female arranged in outbuilding

indicators.note: in means placed within, so the arranged letters sit inside the outbuilding

parts.note: a shed is an outbuilding

indicators.note: arranged signals that the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Life with a woman, arranged in a garden shed.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheffield is a city in South Yorkshire known for steel.

clue.text: See 13
Outspoken about doubtfully fair sort of spectacles

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the outspoken word goes round the rest

parts.note: vocal means outspoken

indicators.note: doubtfully signals that fair is reworked

explanation.surface: Vocal doubts about a fair kind of glasses.
explanation.definitionFit: Varifocal lenses change power gradually from top to bottom, so these glasses have them.

clue.text: City of revolutionary in duty list

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the revolutionary goes into the list

parts.note: a roster is a list of duties
Che Guevara is the classic revolutionary

explanation.surface: A city where a revolutionary appears on a rota.
explanation.definitionFit: Rochester is a cathedral city in Kent, England.

clue.text: Garden pest from Bourges

indicators.note: from here means made out of the letters of the French town, rearranged

explanation.surface: A garden pest coming from a French city.
explanation.definitionFit: A rose bug is a beetle that feeds on roses and other flowers.

clue.text: City transport to disagree with monarch being dropped

parts.note: a car is transport

indicators.note: being dropped means the monarch's letters are removed

parts.note: to differ is to disagree
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: Transport arguing after a monarch is dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: Cardiff is the capital city of Wales.

clue.text: Engineer put in boiler with mount

indicators.note: put in means placed inside, so the engineers go into the stove

parts.note: a hob is a cooking surface where pans are boiled
RE is the Royal Engineers

explanation.surface: An engineer fitted inside a boiler on a mountain.
explanation.definitionFit: Horeb is the biblical mountain where Moses received the law, identified with Sinai.

clue.text: Little piece of music has donor in trouble

indicators.note: in trouble signals letters thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A short musical piece reveals a donor in difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: A rondino is a short rondo, a brief musical composition.

clue.text: Plant raised, when cold inside, in city

indicators.note: inside means the cold letter sits within the raised plant
raised in a down clue means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a herb is a plant

explanation.surface: A plant grown when it is cold inside a city.
explanation.walkthrough: HERB raised gives BREH; C goes in to make BRECH. Brechin is a small cathedral city in Angus, Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Brechin is a Scottish town with a cathedral, giving it the status of city.

clue.text: Flourish backfires

annotationWithheld.why: Flourish backfires (5): SERIF is FIRES reversed, but the one word 'backfires' is both the reversal indicator (back) and the fodder (fires), a word doing two jobs

clue.text: Acknowledgement of superior allusion with changed head

indicators.note: with changed head means the first letter is replaced by another

parts.note: a reference is an allusion

explanation.surface: An allusion to a boss with a fresh leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Deference is respectful submission to someone of higher rank.

clue.text: Miller needs second in what he should do

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the second goes into the duty

parts.note: duty is what one ought to do

explanation.surface: A miller needs a moment for his obligations.
explanation.walkthrough: Dusty is the traditional nickname for anyone called Miller, as millers are covered in flour.
explanation.definitionFit: A miller covered in flour is dusty, hence the customary nickname Dusty Miller.

clue.text: Colourful article on fieldwork

parts.note: red is a colour
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A colourful article about fieldwork.
explanation.definitionFit: A redan is a V-shaped earthwork fortification, a kind of field defence.

clue.text: Liqueur for castles

definitions.meaning: a bailey is the outer wall or courtyard of a castle

explanation.surface: A drink served in castles.
explanation.definitionFit: Baileys is a cream liqueur, and baileys are the walled outer courts of castles.

clue.text: Aquatic larva, drunk and dishonourable?

parts.note: a water insect larva named by someone slurring their words, giving a word for ungentlemanly

explanation.surface: A water insect that is drunk and badly behaved.
explanation.walkthrough: The caddis larva, pronounced by a drunk, slurs its S into SH.
explanation.definitionFit: Caddish means behaving like a cad, ungentlemanly and dishonourable.

clue.text: Fund-raiser at the present time

parts.note: a gift is a present
a day is a period of time

explanation.surface: Raising money at the present moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at the present time' reads as 'now', but splits into present and time.
explanation.definitionFit: A gift day is a day when a church invites donations, a fund-raising event.

clue.text: City shot in the theatre

definitions.meaning: a cathedral city in eastern England
the US president assassinated at Ford's Theatre in 1865

explanation.surface: A city where someone was shot during a play.
explanation.definitionFit: Lincoln is an English city, and Abraham Lincoln was shot at a theatre.
